short: Effect of Ca addition on grain refinement of Mg-9Li-1Al allo
title: Effect of Ca addition on grain refinement of Mg-9Li-1Al alloy

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Adding Ca to Mg-9Li-1Al should form Al2Ca particles that refine the alpha-Mg and beta-Li phases. Base alloy: duplex alpha-Mg + beta-Li Mg-9Li-1Al (LA91).
states.detail: Absorbed: s1 (HYP/hypothesis), s2 (DES/base_system), s3 (DES/modification), s4 (DES/route), s5 (PRC/forming), s6 (PRC/treatment). Premises: beta-Li in Mg-14Li was refined by Mg-40Sr and Mg-30Y master alloys [10,35]

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Al2Ca is the only new phase in LA91-0.2Ca; LA91 contains only alpha-Mg and beta-Li. Sub-micron Al2Ca particles lie along alpha/beta phase boundaries and inside the alpha-Mg matrix of as-cast LA91-0.2Ca.
states.detail: Absorbed: s7 (STR/phase/identity), s8 (STR/microstructure/distribution), s9 (STR/microstructure/shape), s10 (STR/microstructure/feature_size), s11 (STR/microstructure/distribution), s12 (STR/interface). Premises: Edge-to-edge matching model: planes with d-value mismatch fd < 6% containing matching close-packed rows predict a nucleant/matrix OR [11]; beta-Li is bcc, a = 0.351 nm; close-packed planes {110},{211},{200}; Al2Ca is cubic Fd-3m, a = 0.804 nm, 16 Al + 8 Ca per cell; close-packed planes {311},{220},{222}

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Al2Ca particles act as heterogeneous nucleation sites, refining alpha-Mg and beta-Li
states.detail: Absorbed: s13 (MEC/pathway). Premises: Edge-to-edge matching model: planes with d-value mismatch fd < 6% containing matching close-packed rows predict a nucleant/matrix OR [11]

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: 0.2 wt% Ca forms Al2Ca, which turns alpha-Mg granular and halves the extruded beta-Li grain size; crystallographically Al2Ca is a potent refiner for LA91

nodes.head: F1a: alpha-Mg (light, labelled) forms long parallel laths; F1b: alpha-Mg forms mostly blocky equiaxed islands
nodes.solves: With Ca, as-cast alpha-Mg changes from long lath/rod-like plates to granular blocks
nodes.note: alpha-Mg / beta-Li arrow labels are printed in both panels, but the packet lists F1a/F1b as annotated: false (OCR missed them)

nodes.title: MICRO, F1, F3
nodes.head: F1a laths are ~15-40 um wide and at most ~400 um long within the ~675 um field, not 1371.56 x 322.61 um as stated. F1b alpha-Mg granules are ~15-40 um across.
nodes.solves: With Ca, as-cast alpha-Mg changes from long lath/rod-like plates to granular blocks
nodes.note: 100 um bar = 68 px; widths 10-25 px; longest lath ~280 px. Stated width 322.61 um is ~10x the imaged width; stated length exceeds the field text value 28.32 um; consistent 25 um bar = 60 px; technique not stated for F3, contrast matches the etched OM of F1. Text: 10.32 vs 4.56 um
